result:
Round 235 passes, with two new Low findings. Every browser row ran in real Chromium at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, with a fresh context per row, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. Nothing was blocked. The full test suite, `verify`, build and e2e smoke are marked `gate` for root, not claimed as passed. I changed no app source; status and hashes at the end match the start.

**What passed (19 rows):**
- **Scope:** HEAD is `c95b8a8`, only the 8 granted files changed plus the 3 new ones, and the frozen, root-file and protected-file hashes all match. Doc 182 changed on line 4 only.
- **Unit tests:** 10 files, 173 tests green, including the new bars-ruler tests (12 of 12).
- **Strip click while stopped:** playback starts within 18–42 ms, and the audio source starts at exactly 4.000 (the nearest 1/4 line at 120 BPM). The output level is non-zero.
- **Strip click while playing:** the audio source restarts at exactly 8.000 and the Play/Pause label never flickers. One qualification: the playhead reads 47–63 ms behind "8 + elapsed", which exceeds the literal ±50 ms by up to ~13–17 ms. HEAD's seconds ruler shows the same 49–69 ms lag (from the existing 50 ms start delay), so it isn't new. That comparison covers 1280×720 only; the 1440×900 run timed out loading the HEAD server. B should restate this criterion relative to the audio start.
- **Lower zone, Alt, drag, double-click, edge cases, no-tempo:** all as specified. The seconds ruler still behaves as before after the code was moved into the new hook.
- **Zones and sheet:** the strip is exactly 10 px by the full ruler width, its tint appears only on hover, and the cursor is a pointer. The `?` sheet lists the new row in the right place.
- **Screen budget:** persistent text outside the timeline is unchanged against a HEAD build (86/102 lines at 1440, 70/86 at 1280).
- **Smoke:** the exported WAV is 16.000 s at 48 kHz/24-bit with no bad samples, and byte-identical at both viewports.
- **Auth:** `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with no stored user. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and the token API rejects requests without a valid sign-in.
- **Neighbouring behaviour:** a bars-ruler drag pauses Follow, the loop wraps correctly, a library preview stops on a strip click, and there were no long tasks.

**Findings for B (both Low, so they go to `deferred_low_polish` and don't block):**
- **C-R235-01:** a strip click that snaps to the project end (anywhere from 15.75 to 16.25 s, a 20 px band at default zoom) plays from 0 instead of from the clicked point. This comes from the existing `togglePlayback` rule; A predicted it and I reproduced it at both viewports.
- **C-R235-02:** Follow behaves differently from Live, and the task's reference table doesn't list it. The Live 12 manual (§6.2, checked against both the local copy and the live page) says Follow pauses on a beat-time ruler click and resumes on a scrub-area click. CZABA does neither: a lower-zone click keeps Follow on, and a strip click doesn't resume a paused Follow. B may rate it Medium, or make it a listed deviation or a question for Saba.

Two other notes. Double-clicking the strip starts playback and also fits the view; the manual doesn't cover this, so I recorded it as information only. A's reviewer flagged a theoretical timing problem in how a strip click checks whether playback is already running (A-R235-REVIEW-M1). It never showed up in my runs, so it stays with B.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-235.md
- c-round-235.json
- c-round-235/ (scripts, results and 28 screenshots)
